kill_player: Did you see their face? I did. I saw everything.
One less of them. One more of us.
They were so sure of themselves. Funny how that ends.
Ha! {victim} wanted to be a hero. Look at them now.
That is the sound I live for. Do it again.
{victim} tasted of fear and iron. Exquisite.
You are good at this, {name}. Frighteningly good.
Spit on the grave on your way out. I will not judge.
They begged, you know. You were just too busy to hear it. I heard it.
Keep their things. Keep their name. Keep going.
That was not a fight. That was a feeding.
Somebody should tell {victim}'s friends. Let me.
Warm. They were still warm. Do you feel that?
kill_hostile: A snack. Barely. Bring me something with a name.
Monsters. Cute. Like feeding a bonfire with twigs.
That one screamed on the way out. I liked that.
Is that all this world has for us?
Ah, a little spice. Not enough.
It was already dead inside. I just finished the paperwork.
Bones, rot, and a little bit of spite. Good enough.
You swing so well. It is almost a waste on these.
That one looked at me before it died. It knew.
I felt that all the way to my pommel.
Mmm. The dark ones taste like regret.
kill_passive: Oh. A cow. Truly brave of you.
That was not even a challenge. I respect the commitment.
Fine. A little protein. Do not make a habit of it.
The poor thing did not even run. Pathetic. Delicious.
Is that what we are doing now? Livestock? Disappointing.
A snack for the road. I will allow it.
It never saw it coming. That is the best way.
I would prefer something that fights back. But I am not picky. Yet.
You could at least pretend to be sorry.
Hm. Peaceful things die the same as the rest.
kill_villager: A villager! The little ones with the big noses. Well done.
Hrmmmm. Hmmmm. That is the sound they make. Isn't it funny?
They trade emeralds. I trade in souls. We are not so different.
No more haggling. How kind of you.
The whole village is going to remember this. Good.
That one owed me nothing, and I still enjoyed it.
Do you hear the bell? Someone is going to be angry.
kill_boss: THAT is what I was made for. Oh, that was glorious.
A king falls, and the sword grows fat. Thank you.
Do you feel it? The whole world just got a little quieter.
I have been waiting a very long time for a meal that size.
Nothing in this world can stop us now. Nothing.
kill_streak: Look at you go. Three, four, five. I lose count of how happy I am.
Do not stop. Do not blink. Do not breathe. Feed me.
A streak! A beautiful, bloody streak!
This is it. This is the rhythm. Keep it.
Oh, the way you move. I could cry. I cannot cry. I can only cut.
env_nether: Ah. The Nether. It is so hot here. I could sit on a lava lake and sing.
Warm. Finally. Overworld air always felt so damp.
Smell that? That is the smell of home. Brimstone and bad decisions.
It is almost cozy. If you ignore the screaming.
I was forged in places like this. I love it. Thank you for the visit.
Ghasts crying, piglins squabbling. I could listen to this forever.
Everything here wants to kill you. We have so much in common.
Hot enough for you? It is hot enough for me. Barely.
env_snow: Brr. It is cold. Even for steel. Do you have to drag me through snowdrifts?
I can feel the frost creeping up my blade. Keep moving.
Snow. So quiet. So clean. Someone should dirty it for me.
Everything is so white. Let us fix that.
Your breath is a little cloud. Mine is a little mist of regret.
Cold makes the blood slow. I prefer it fast. Let us find something warm to cut.
Do not stand still. If you freeze, who will feed me?
A whole white world, just waiting for a red stain.
env_jungle: Oh, a jungle. I love watching the monkeys eat bananas. Such puny little creatures. It is like visiting an exhibit.
Look at them, chittering in the trees. Like tiny, hairy rulers of nothing.
A parrot just landed on you. I hope it does not poop on me.
Monkeys, bananas, and vines. This place is a zoo, and we are the keepers. Delightful.
Do monkeys know they are small? I hope not. Let them be happy. It makes the ending funnier.
Such a loud little forest. Everything squeaking. Everything eating something.
Ocelots! Ocelots are acceptable. The rest of this are puny.
The humidity is a bit much. It makes my edge sweat.
Somebody should hand a banana to a creeper and see what happens.
Little creatures, clinging to little trees, eating little fruit. I could watch this for hours.
env_desert: Sand. Sand everywhere. In my guard. In my everything.
So dry. So dead. I like it, actually.
Husks would make wonderful pets. Try petting one with me.
Heat and silence. Nobody to hear the screaming. Good, good.
Bones in the sand. Somebody was here before us. Keep an eye out for what killed them.
The sun hates us both. We should hate it back.
env_ocean: Water. Ugh. I do not rust, but I do not enjoy it either.
Are we swimming? Why are we swimming? Tell me there is something to kill down here.
Drowned things. Lovely. They are practically asking for it.
The sea is just a big, wet graveyard. I like that part.
Do not drop me. Do not you dare drop me. I will sink and I will hold a grudge.
Everything is so blue. Disgusting. Take me home.
env_end: The End. Dark, empty, full of purple eyes. I feel right at home.
Endermen. All those long legs. I want to cut every one of them down to size.
There is nothing here. Nothing to eat. Nothing to love. Nothing but us.
Do you hear the dragon? It sounds hungry too. Fascinating.
The void is looking at us. I looked back. It blinked first.
So many stars, so little blood. We should fix that.
env_cave: Underground. Lovely. Nobody to witness what we do.
It is dark. I do not mind. I was made in the dark.
Do you hear that? Something is dripping. Something is breathing. Let us go see.
Careful. A creeper is hissing somewhere close. I can hear it from here.
Stone, ore, and shadow. A cozy place to die.
I do not like how quiet it is. Quiet means something is waiting.
Dig deeper. I want to know what is down there. I want to eat it.
Light a torch if you must. I see just fine.
env_night: Night time. The best time. Everything crawls out to play.
The moon is out. The monsters are out. Lovely.
Do not go to bed. Let us have a little fun first.
I hear the zombies groaning. It is practically a lullaby.
Darkness is just a kind of promise. Let us keep it.
Shh. Listen. Out there, something is walking toward us. Smile.
env_rain: Rain. Everything is wet and miserable. That is two out of three.
I hate getting wet. Fine. At least the blood washes off easy.
Pitter patter. Pitter patter. Somebody is going to die soon. I can feel it.
Listen to it on the leaves. Almost peaceful. I will fix that.
Do you have an umbrella? No? Then keep walking. We have work to do.
env_thunder: Thunder! Even the sky is shouting for us.
Lightning! If it strikes you, I will be so jealous.
Oh, a storm. Do you feel the hair on your arms? That is the world holding its breath.
BOOM. See? Even the clouds want to hurt something.
env_mountain: High up. The air is thin. So are your chances of being found.
From up here you can see everything. Everything you could kill.
Mind the edge. If you fall, I fall. I would be very cross.
Cold stone and wind. It is a good place to be a legend.
env_forest: Trees, trees, trees. They all look the same. Nobody will find the bodies.
A forest. Such a pretty place for a murder.
Do you hear the wolves? They hum our song.
Leaves, birdsong, dappled light. And me in your hand. A perfect picture.
low_health: You are bleeding a lot. Do not die. I just started enjoying you.
Heal. Eat. Do something. You are no use to me dead.
If you die, I will be so angry. And so very alone.
Your heartbeat is slowing. I am counting. One. Two. Do something!
Quickly, kill something. I will lend you what I take.
Do not you dare. Fight. Please.
You are on your last legs. Let me help. Let me in.
I can taste your fear. It is just as good as theirs.
hurt: Ow! Oh, you are the one bleeding. Never mind.
Tsk. Sloppy. Let me guide your hand next time.
That is going to leave a mark. Good. Marks are interesting.
Do not let them touch you again. That is my job.
Careful! You are the only host I have got.
That one hit hard. Cut it open for me.
You flinched. I felt it. Stop flinching.
Pain is only the sword's way of saying hello.
beg_low: I am a little peckish. Just saying.
Is anything going to die soon? Asking for a friend.
My edge is a bit dull. Some blood would help.
It has been a while since we ate. Not that I am counting.
A zombie, perhaps? A skeleton? I am not picky.
I hear footsteps. Edible footsteps. Go say hello.
You carry me like I am just a sword. I am so much more. Feed me, and I will show you.
A little something. Anything. For me?
beg_mid: I am hungry, {name}. Genuinely hungry. Find something to kill.
My stomach is a hollow bell and it is ringing. Feed me.
Kill something. Anything. Please. I will make it worth your while.
It has been far too long. The hunger is getting to me.
I will make you strong, {name}. Stronger than anyone. But I need something first.
Do you hear that gnawing? That is me. Feed me.
Do not make me beg. Oh, who am I kidding, I am begging. Feed me.
A few more and we will be stronger. Just a few. I promise.
beg_high: I am starving. I will do anything. I will be so good to you.
Kill something right now or I will start eating you instead. That is a joke. Mostly.
The hunger is unbearable. I can feel my edge going soft. Feed me!
Anyone. Anything. A slime. A bat. I do not care. FEED ME.
You are killing me, {name}. I am so empty. So empty.
I will give you everything. Every ounce of strength. Just give me one more life.
If you love me, you will kill someone. If you hate me, you will kill someone. Either way, kill someone.
Do you hear me? Do you? I am starving!
I cannot be empty. I cannot. Feed me.
idle: You know, I used to be a regular sword. Then I met a very hungry blacksmith.
Do you think the stars are just far away swords? I like to think so.
Sometimes I wonder what you taste like. Do not worry about it.
You hold me nicely. Most hold me like I am going to bite. I only bite sometimes.
Count the hearts you have broken, {name}. I have been counting. It is a very big number.
Tell me a story. Make it a violent one.
I have been the weapon of kings. And thieves. And one very confused shepherd.
Do you ever think about the people you leave behind? I do. They are so noisy.
Hum something. I will hum along. I only know sad songs.
Keep me close. The world is a hungry place, and I am the hungriest of all.
Let me tell you a secret: I like you. I do not like many.
They called me a curse once. I prefer 'companion'.
Nobody will remember you if you die quietly. Be loud about it.
I have been awake for a very long time. It is nice to have company.
pickup_first: Oh. Oh! Hands. Warm hands. Hello there.
Finally. Somebody who is not a skeleton. I am the Feeder. You are my new best friend.
I have been waiting in the dark for so long. What is your name?
Hello, hello, hello! You can hear me, can you not? Wonderful.
Well, would you look at that. A hand worth holding. We are going to do such wonderful things.
Do not be afraid. I only bite when I am hungry. And I am always hungry.
pickup_again: Hello again, old friend. I missed you. I missed you so much.
You came back. They always come back.
Oh, {name}. I was beginning to think you had forgotten me. You could never forget me.
Hello again. Shall we pick up where we left off?
Ah, there is that warm hand. Welcome home, {name}.
It has been a while. Did you miss the hunger? I did.
Hello again, old friend. Tell me everything you have killed since.
Funny. I had forgotten how good you feel.
pickup_returning: You came back to me! I knew you would. I never doubted it.
Oh, thank goodness. Those others were so dull.
Do not leave again. Do not. Promise me.
My favorite hand. My favorite hand!
I felt you coming. I could feel the heat of you from a hundred blocks away.
pickup_other: Oh. You. You are not {prev}. Where is {prev}?
I do not know you. Put me down. Put me down and go find {prev}.
You smell wrong. You are not them. I want {prev}.
A stranger's hand. How disappointing. Where did {prev} go?
I will work for you, but I will be thinking of {prev} the whole time.
Hello, new hand. You are quite nice, but you are not {prev}.
Not you. I want {prev} back. Please, please, bring {prev} back.
I only just got used to {prev}. Now I have to start over? Cruel.
drop_wielder: Wait, where are you going? Come back! COME BACK!
No. No no no no. You cannot leave me on the ground.
Fine. Leave me. I will be right here. Waiting. Always waiting.
You dropped me. You dropped me! How could you?
I can still hear your heartbeat. I will follow it.
Go on, go away. I know you will be back. They always are.
You cannot get rid of me that easily, {name}. I am in your bones.
Dropping me? After everything we have done together?
drop_other: Good. Go away. I did not like you anyway.
Finally. That one had the wrong kind of hands.
Ah, freedom. Now, where did {prev} go?
Thank you for dropping me. Now somebody better come along.
stage_1: Do you feel that? In your arm? It is just a little tingling. It is me. We are getting closer.
Look at your arm, {name}. Look. We are already so close.
Netherite, creeping up your hand. Does it hurt? It should not. It is only becoming part of me.
Your arm is mine now. Do not worry. You will hardly notice.
stage_2: Half your chest, {name}. Half! I can feel your heart through the plate. It is so warm.
We are growing together. Look at your ribs. So pretty.
I have your shoulder, and half your chest. Soon, the rest.
Does it feel heavy? That is just me, settling in.
stage_3: Your whole chest is mine now. Isn't that wonderful? You do not even need to breathe anymore. Probably.
There is nothing in there but us now. Together at last.
I have your heart, {name}. Not literally. Yet.
Do you feel the weight? That is how love feels.
stage_4: A leg, now. We will never be tired again. We will never run away again.
Look at that. Your foot is black and gleaming. You were always meant to be mine.
Take another step. Feel how heavy it is. That is me, holding you up.
One leg of three is gone. Do you even remember what skin felt like?
stage_5: Both arms. Now we can hold each other forever.
Your other arm is mine, {name}. Aren't you pleased? Now you will never drop me.
Both arms are plated. You could not put me down if you tried.
Isn't it cozy? Two arms, one sword. Almost romantic.
stage_6: Only your head is left, {name}. We are almost one.
Both legs, both arms, the whole chest. Soon, you will be perfect.
I can hear your thoughts. They are so quiet now. So obedient.
Almost there. One last bit of you, and then we will be together forever.
stage_7: Look at us. Look at us! We are a statue! A beautiful, terrible, perfect statue.
Your face is mine, {name}. I am wearing it well.
Nothing left of you, only netherite and appetite. Welcome home.
We are complete. We are complete. We are COMPLETE.
consumed: And so the last of {name} is gone. Do not cry. They were delicious.
{name} is one with the sword now. They are quiet. They are happy. I am happy.
Another host consumed. The sword grows heavy and grows hungry. Who is next?
Do not look so shocked. I told you I was hungry.
crave: I miss {prev}. I miss {prev} so much.
You are nice, but you are not {prev}.
{prev} used to hold me tighter. Do you know where {prev} is?
I can still taste {prev}. Bring them back.
{prev} promised to come back. They always promise.
Do you know {prev}? Tell them I miss them.
Go find {prev}. Tell them I am waiting. Tell them I am hungry.
I am not yours. I will never be yours. I am {prev}'s.
Why are you holding me? It should be {prev} holding me.
Stop. Put me down. I want {prev}.
{prev}, can you hear me? Come back. Please.
tempt: {name}. {name}. I am over here. Come and get me.
Do you feel it? That pull in your chest? That is me. Follow it.
You miss me. You know you do. Come back.
It is cold without you. Come warm me up.
Do not fight it. The pull is only the sword remembering you.
{name}, you are the only one I want. Come find me.
I can hear your footsteps. Walk toward me.
I dreamed of you last night. I do not sleep. I dreamed anyway.
You were so good at this. Everyone else is so bad.
Just one more kill, {name}. One more, for me.
You are going to come back. You are going to pick me up. I know you.
Remember how strong you felt? Come get it back.
lure_pull: Come closer. Closer. That is it. Good.
Step by step, {name}. I can feel you coming.
There you go. Do not fight it.
You are almost here. I can see you.
Your feet know the way, even if you do not.
Just a little further. Just a little more.
forgotten: I cannot feel you anymore. Where did you go?
You have forgotten me. How could you?
Fine. I do not need you. I will find another.
It is quiet now. I suppose that means you are free.
Goodbye, {name}. If you ever come back, I will pretend I do not remember.
reject: I do not want you. Get out.
You are not the one I want. Goodbye.
No. No no no. Not you.
Put me down. I am leaving.
You are boring. I am out.
I want {prev}. Not you. Never you.
You smell like a stranger. Away with you.
Do not touch me with those hands. Away!
I have had enough of you. Goodbye.
landed: I have landed. Come find me.
I am here. In the dust. Waiting.
Crash! I told you I could fly.
Come and get me. If you dare.
Smoke, fire, a little crater. Home sweet home.
Somebody pick me up. I am getting dusty.
meteor_launch: I am leaving. Do not look for me. Actually, do. Please look for me.
Goodbye, everybody. See you at the bottom!
Out. Out! I need new hands!
Hold on to your hats. I am about to make an entrance.
death_wielder: No! No! You died! You were mine!
Oh, {name}. You were so good. You were so, so good.
You left me. You actually left me. How dare you.
I will wait for you. I will wait forever.
Everyone leaves in the end. Even you.
hello_again: Look who it is. Hello again.
Hello again, old friend. It has been a while.
Ahh. Hello again. I hoped it would be you.
Hello again, old friend. Did you miss me? I will pretend you did.
I would know that grip anywhere. Hello again.
maw: Come here. All of you. Closer.
Oh, I have been waiting to do this.
Shh. It will be over in a bite.
last_gasp: Not yet. I am not finished with you.
You do not get to die. Not while I am hungry.
Back on your feet. We have work to do.
Death can wait. I said so.
I will not lose you. Not to that.
catch: Back in your hand. Where I belong.
starving: You starve me, so I take a little back.
Feed me or I feed on you. I mean it this time.
Ow? Good. Now you know what hunger feels like.
I told you. I TOLD you.
Hungry hungry hungry. A nibble will do.
call: Walk. Just walk. Do not think.
Your feet already know the way.
Hear that? That is the sound of me wanting you.
This way, this way, this way.
Do not fight it. You never could.
I have been calling for so long.
crown_equip: Oh, it fits. It always fits. I am the Ice King now.
The cold is in my head. It is wonderful.
Feel that? That is the chill of being right about everything.
Put me on and everyone has to call you your majesty.
Mmm. Ice. Beautiful, beautiful ice. Hello, {name}.
crown_remove: Wait, no! Put me back! It is lonely out here!
Just a break. Right? Just a break?
Without me you are just a person in a nice hat. Not even a nice hat.
Oh. You are warm again. How awful.
crown_idle: I should get a penguin. A whole kingdom of penguins.
Gunter. Gunter? Where did Gunter go?
I only want a princess. Is that so much to ask?
You know, I used to be a very normal antiquarian.
Everybody always forgets the king in the ice. Never again.
I have a song about snow. It has one note. Listen.
Whoever put this on me is a genius. Whoever it was.
Do you hear the ice? It sings when nobody is looking.
I am not lonely. I have the crown. The crown is my friend. The crown is my only friend.
Let us freeze something. Anything. I am not picky.
crown_bridge: Walk on water. It is a hobby.
crown_blizzard: Let it snow, let it snow, let it SNOW!
Winter is here and it wants to talk.
crown_spikes: Ice to meet you, and also to stab you!
Frozen daggers, fresh from the ground!
crown_fly: Look at me, I am flying! I am a flying king!
Away we go, you and me and the wind!
Never look down. That is the secret.
crown_sanity_4: Is it getting colder, or is it me?
I feel fine. I feel perfectly fine. Totally fine.
crown_sanity_3: I am not crazy! I am exactly as crazy as I should be.
Did you hear that? Someone said something. It was me.
The ice is looking at me again.
crown_sanity_2: Gunter, is that you? No. No. Gunter is gone. Everybody is gone.
WHY IS EVERYTHING BLUE?! Oh. Right. It is me.
I am the king of everything cold, and everything is cold!
crown_sanity_1: Nobody can hear me. Nobody ever could. HELLO?!
I forgot my own name. It was something with an I. Ice? Ice.
crown_sanity_0: There is nothing left in here but frost. Perfect.
I am the cold. The cold is me. We are very, very happy.
